module: Console VM script: runs the bananabench benchmark (bench.physics()) then writes the results in CSV format (columns Vehicle, Count, MBeams, RealTime, SpawnTime, ExecTime) to the screen and to a file. The file name is the second command-line argument (`args[2]`), otherwise `bananabench.csv`.
notes: Bug: the headers are `SpawnTime,ExecTime` but the values written are, in order, r.time (simulation time) then r.spawntime (spawn time): the two columns are swapped relative to their titles.
The script runs on load (no exported function) and uses the global `args` provided by the console launcher.
The file is opened with io.open (disk path).
